_note: Curated sacred-history anchor events. Tier A (public-domain factual history), original prose only, each carries a Wikidata QID for provenance. These augment the bounded Wikidata proof-run seed with sacred-history-relevant datable points (councils, foundings, canonizations, manuscript discoveries, founder lifespans). Hand-curated 2026-06-12; dates are conventional scholarly placements and are surfaced as claim-backed, not as settled fact.

events.label: Composition of the Rigveda
events.note: Oral composition of the oldest Vedic hymns; conventionally placed c. 1500-1200 BCE.

events.label: Traditional floruit of Zoroaster
events.note: Dating ranges widely across scholarship, from the 2nd millennium to the 6th century BCE.

events.label: Life of Gautama Buddha
events.note: Conventional placement c. 6th-5th century BCE; the exact dates remain debated.

events.label: Life of Mahavira
events.note: 24th and last Tirthankara of the present age; traditionally c. 599-527 BCE.

events.label: Life of Confucius
events.note: Conventionally 551-479 BCE.

events.label: Traditional life of Laozi
events.note: Historicity and dates are uncertain; tradition places him as an older contemporary of Confucius.

events.label: Greek translation of the Hebrew scriptures (Septuagint)
events.note: Began with the Torah in Alexandria in the 3rd century BCE; the rest followed over the next two centuries.

events.label: Life of Jesus of Nazareth
events.note: Most scholarship places his birth c. 6-4 BCE and death c. 30-33 CE.

events.label: Council of Jerusalem
events.note: Early apostolic meeting described in Acts; conventionally dated c. 48-50 CE.

events.label: First Council of Nicaea
events.note: Convened by Constantine; produced the original Nicene Creed and addressed the dating of Easter.

events.label: Council of Chalcedon
events.note: Defined the two natures of Christ; a fault line between Chalcedonian and Oriental Orthodox traditions.

events.label: Redaction of the Babylonian Talmud
events.note: Editorial closing conventionally placed around the 5th-6th century CE.

events.label: Life of Muhammad
events.note: Conventionally c. 570-632 CE.

events.label: The Hijra (migration to Medina)
events.note: Year 1 of the Islamic (Hijri) calendar.

events.label: Compilation of the Uthmanic codex of the Qur'an
events.note: Standardization of the consonantal text under the caliph Uthman, conventionally c. 650 CE.

events.label: Life of Guru Nanak
events.note: Founder of Sikhism, 1469-1539 CE.

events.label: Compilation of the Adi Granth
events.note: First compilation of the Sikh scripture by Guru Arjan.

events.label: Publication of the Book of Mormon
events.note: Published by Joseph Smith; founding text of the Latter Day Saint movement.

events.label: Declaration of Baha'u'llah
events.note: Baha'u'llah's declaration of his mission, conventionally dated to 1863 in Baghdad.

events.label: Discovery of the Dead Sea Scrolls
events.note: Manuscripts found in the Qumran caves, including some of the oldest surviving Hebrew biblical texts.

events.label: Discovery of the Nag Hammadi library
events.note: A cache of early Christian and Gnostic codices found in Upper Egypt.
